notes.title: Language Update!
notes.content:
Hello fellow woodsers!

We are delighted to announce that we have released a major update that not only fixes a some (mostly minor) bugs, we've also included 15 new languages!

Play A Day in the Woods in English, Dutch, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish, Indonesian, Russian, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, German, French, Polish, Swedish and Italian.

Changelog
Added localization support
Fixed the long standing Reset Progress bug
Updated engine version so Woods should be more performant
Various minor bugs

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: 13 November Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thanks to feedback from players we were able to stomp some end game bugs!


Fixed game outro hang and missing related achievement.
Fixed incorrect awarding of Reigning Monarch achievement, this achievement will be revoked for everyone, but will be re-awarded when the game starts again if achieved legitimately.


Thanks for the feedback!

PS. Some of you may have noticed that there were two updates, the first was the wrong version, the correct one should be up and available now.
